planningNotice: Author planning: plans, growth stages and hypotheses are not committed facts. Gaps are advisory, never errors.
gapNotice: Distance within planned chapters only; not a continuity error.
derivedNotice: Read-only projection of existing plot/arc data. Edit its chapter card or create an editable planning line.
noLines: No plot lines yet. Add one or ask AI for suggestions from selected chapters.
manageLines: Edit plot lines and growth stages
observationNotice: Bind an exact current manuscript quote. This remains an author observation, not a State commit.
evidenceMissing: The exact quote is missing from the current manuscript.
evidenceBound: Current source revision bound. Save the matrix to retain it.
deleteLineConfirm: Delete this matrix planning line? Chapters, scenes, manuscript and State remain intact.
aiPlanNotice: Sends at most 20 selected chapter cards. Suggestions need manual selection, editing and save; no character or Canon writes.
sendDirector: Open manuscript and review context for director
scenePlanNotice: Edits the planning card only; manuscript, Canon and committed events remain intact.
confirmWrittenPlan: Confirm editing the written chapter plan, without changing manuscript.
savedPlanning: Planning saved; formal story facts unchanged.
discard: Discard unsaved matrix edits and refresh?
needManuscript: Create a manuscript draft for this chapter first.
sceneContextReview: Scene selected. Review the scene and character knowledge, approve context, then open Creative Director.
statisticsNotice: Calculated locally without AI. Measurements reveal rhythm and repetition, not literary quality. The initial chapter heading is excluded; locations still refer to the original file.
deltaNotice: Deltas describe measurements, not proof that a revision is better.
noRepetition: No repetition under these rules; not a full literary verdict.
staleStats: Manuscript changed. Snapshot retained; reanalyze before locating evidence.
unclosedQuote: Unclosed quotation marks: quoted-text ratio may be incomplete.
paragraphNotice: Each item: paragraph · Han count / quoted Han count. First 120 shown; snapshot retains measurements.
explicitScenes: Uses explicit separators, not guessed semantic scenes.
unknownScenes: No explicit scene boundaries. Whole document measured as one segment; semantic scene count unknown.
mentionNotice: Mentions may be memories, calls or hearsay, not physical presence. Identical names remain ambiguous.
methodNotice: Jieba accurate segmentation, HMM off. Sentences use Chinese terminal punctuation and newlines. Balanced quotes may include citations or inner speech; no speaker attribution. Exact repetition does not determine literary intent.
sceneLimit: Explicit boundaries and name mentions assist reading, not replace it. No English readability formula.
distributionCapped: Distribution detail capped at 1,000 items; totals are complete.
includeStatistics: Include local measurements in literary review
readerNotice: Subjective simulated AI feedback, not a reader survey. Only the selected contiguous prose is read; no Canon, secrets, future outlines or past reports.
readerRangeNotice: Current chapter only by default. Added chapters must be consecutive, one version per chapter, at most 8 chapters / 100,000 characters.
subjective: Simulated subjective opinion, not survey evidence
contextMeasurement: Budget uses JSON characters. Token ranges are approximate, not tokenizer usage, model limits or billing.
contextFreshness: Sources and State fingerprints are rechecked on approval and use. External changes require fresh approval.
hiddenNotEnumerated: Hidden secrets are not enumerated in exclusions, preventing leakage through negative instructions. Prior prose, simulations and research do not grant character knowledge.
factPipeline: Evidence → author classification and approval → semantic Final Check → Memory Keeper proposed diff → validation → separate author State Commit. Saving observations or accepting an inference never directly updates formal facts.
factLimitNotice: Prioritize consequential changes, not routine micro-actions. A bounded list is not exhaustive chapter State extraction; existing Memory Keeper and Final validation still apply.
